analysis_scope: Descriptive pilot with one constructed factory split and two whole held-out recordings; frames/tones/seeds are not24independent sites. No adjusted service superiority or global SOTA claim.
anti_collapse_scope: Rank alone is not sufficiency. Evaluate pooledz, RFtokens andpowerbypass separately. Constantprojector protected by regularizing aligned coordinates; renderer alone is not assumed to prevent collapse.
architecture: Shared receiver-set attention with RF-to-query association; pooled48D z + receiver tokens + separate measured power coordinate; independent projector; no EMA/future-window/map residual. Physical relative-delay basis renderer vs direct decoder.
auxiliary_fits: Eighteen frozen linear XYprobes, two RF ridge directions and one rawRF XYridge; four fixed validationalpha choices each; not additional independent sites.

baselines.probe: Frozen z_A linear XY probe; TRAINlabels onlyfit, validationalpha, TESTlabels evaluation. Also rawvisibleRF->XYridge.

checkpoint: Minimum spatial validation bidirectional RF RMSE; earliest epoch ties; identical across cells/seeds. No test choice or refit after test.
eligibility: Every selected encoder/target power bin must be measured-positive and above numeric -120dB floor; report rejected rows. Zeros are not invented negative RF measurements.
loss: Common bidirectional observed log-power Huber(delta3dB); alignmentWeight.1 only JEPA cells. PriorWeight.01 average of same prior applied to backbone z and aligned projector. Matched regression removes alignment only.
observations: FFTshift actual complexCSI; contiguous16-tone LINEARpower average then log10 to64 bins. Referenced-channel dB is not dBm/SNR; receiver ARRAYCENTERS are not per-element aperture geometry. Physical antennas are grouped by actual array metadata; mean LINEAR power over array members before log; query geometry is ARRAYCENTER. Endpoint is array power, not per-element complex CSI or angle recovery.

rt_track.scope: Actual Sionna RT solves with simulateddevice frontends; not real device readings or closed-loop packet trials.

split.rule: Y60/80quantiles,.25mguard; pose only for indexing/probe, never encoder input

study: SCENE-JEPA measured simultaneous-array power pilot and physical-view infrastructure
temporal_scope: Different-time auxiliary baseline, not asserted beyond coherence for every sample. Common measurement prediction task remains simultaneous.
training_scope: First1024 real factory records; constructed pose-blocked split, not the official DICHASUS benchmark. Same519 chronological-pair-eligible source frames for every cell; paired targets remain inside spatial TRAIN.
